family_findings: SceneSweeper::Construct calls the component Construct and Register; Construct binds the SceneSweeper owner, initializes draw distance to 50.0 and clears both display toggles. The existing component OnActivate registers exactly these three fields in the frozen ARTIST order.

RenderWorld connects the two booleans to the Dynamic and Inactive interval-list getters. RenderIntervalList consumes the draw-distance field, camera position, interval endpoints and object-index assertion before calling the 3D DrawBox path. SceneSweeper source owns the interval lists and their sweep/build updates.

The current CgsSceneSweeper.h has an older FLAG comment saying the component is opaque and its body absent; the current header/cpp instead embeds the named component and defines its body. The included vendor rwcore_structs.h defines rw::RGBA, so the same stale comment claim that the type has no home is no longer true in this source tree.

The four-channel rw::RGBA constructor is declared in the pinned vendor header. A bounded text search of b5-decomp/vendor/renderware found the declaration but no matching definition; unrelated source trees and binary libraries were not searched. The external link provider is therefore unknown because compile/link was prohibited. This does not establish a missing owner body for the three registrations.
All three original behavior dispositions remain pending. This map is not a native/runtime parity verdict.
